newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: U.S. team to visit Nicaragua on property disputes.
newsitem.headline: U.S. team to visit Nicaragua on property disputes.

text.p: A U.S. government delegation will visit Nicaragua for four days next week to discuss the claims of U.S. citizens whose properties were confiscated by the former left-wing Sandinista government, U.S. officials said on Friday.

The five-person team, due to arrive on Wednesday and leave on Feb. 22, will be headed by John Hamilton, the U.S. deputy assistant secretary of state for Central America and the Caribbean, a U.S. embassy press release said. The delegation will meet with the new government of President Arnoldo Aleman during the visit,
While many U.S. citizens have been compensated for their confiscated properties, more than 1,000 still have outstanding claims for properties in Nicaragua. the embassy said.
"For us the cases of North American citizens are top priority," U.S. ambassador to Nicaragua Lino Gutierrez said.
